changes.before: The largest maximum water translation was 0.0259504 angstrom, with Hessian change $2.4182008\times10^{-4}$ in elementary charge per cubic angstrom.
changes.after: For each corrected configuration, the translation statistic is the maximum Euclidean norm of the translation vector over its eight rigid waters, measured from the baseline configuration. The largest such statistic across the three recorded corrected configurations was 0.0259504 angstrom. At that same corrected configuration, the change from baseline in the $xx$ component of the potential Hessian at the first synthetic site was $2.4182008\times10^{-4}$ in elementary charge per cubic angstrom.
